:::{#exm-partial-correlation-precision}
#### The partial correlations of a chain of three Gaussian variables

<!-- no-figure: arithmetic on one 3 x 3 matrix; nothing to plot -->

Let $\vX = \tp{(X_1, X_2, X_3)}$ be the Gaussian vector of @exm-precision-zero-cind,
with

$$
\precision(\vX) = \pmat{2 & -1 & 0 \\ -1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & 2}.
$$

By @thm-partial-correlation-precision, the [partial correlation](#def-partial-correlation) of $X_1$ and $X_2$ given $X_3$ is

$$
\frac{-\precision(\vX)_{12}}{\sqrt{\precision(\vX)_{11}\precision(\vX)_{22}}}
= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2 \cdot 2}}
= \frac{1}{2},
$$

and the partial correlation of $X_1$ and $X_3$ given $X_2$ is $-0 / \sqrt{2 \cdot 2} = 0$,
as @thm-precision-zero-cind says for a zero element,
although their [correlation](variance-covariance.qmd#def-correlation) is not zero.

:::
